A '''carrot''' is a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Night Vision}}. Eaten raw, it heals {{Value|Carrot|heals}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/carrot.json}}</ref> It is the ingredient of [[Steamed Carrots|steamed carrots]], [[Pickled Carrots|pickled carrots]], [[Carrot Cupcake|carrot cupcake]]s, [[Pad Thai]] and [[lumpia]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Farming ===
Carrot crops drop the pack's carrots. A fully grown crop drops 2 to 8 carrots, where vanilla drops 2 to 5: its extra carrots are rolled twice, once with Fortune's bonus and once with the Electrum tool intrinsic's, and each roll adds 0 to 3 carrots even without the enchantment. Each level of either enchantment adds one more chance of an extra carrot.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/carrots.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a carrot heals {{Value|Carrot|heals}}.

Picking up a carrot unlocks steamed carrots, pickled carrots, carrot cupcakes and Pad Thai. Carrots are also used in [[Golden Carrot|golden carrot]]s, [[gimmari]], [[bokguk]], [[seitan]], [[Curry Stock|curry stock]] and [[Pumpkin Curry Stock|pumpkin curry stock]].
